[[Hardcore Mode|{{Color|HardcoreMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 45 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]8,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4)
[[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2, Heal) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Heal}}''' - Raises its arms, creating an incantation circle which restores the health of enemies in its radius and itself by 2.5% of their maximum health every 0.2 seconds, and walks at a slower speed. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Health Cultist''' is a support-type [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] and only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. The '''Health Cultist''' heals enemies within its range. Healed enemies are visually indicated by a glowing green incantation circle underneath them and floating green crystals around them. This will heal enemies by 2.5% of the maximum health every 0.2 seconds. As it heals other enemies, it will cause problems if not dealt with quickly. When it is not healing, the '''Health Cultist''' walks quite quickly, but its legs do not move. When it is healing enemies, it walks quite slowly. It also has quite high health. ==Appearance== The '''Health Cultist''' appears to be a normal-sized [[Enemies|enemy]] with a dark black granite robe. Some parts of the robe are light green. Green spikes stick out from its neck. It also wears a black granite hood over its faceless head. Its skin is black, reflective and metallic. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Health Cultist''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Due to the fact that the '''Health Cultist''' can heal itself and other enemies, it must be dealt with as soon as possible. **This effectively makes enemies with high health unkillable for the duration of its ability. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended, as their DPS may outpace '''Health Cultist's''' healing ability. **The [[Ranger]] can also be quite useful against the '''Health Cultist''', as its high damage allows it to take out enemies quickly, leaving the '''Health Cultist''' with no time to heal them. ***Be aware that if you are using small groups of [[Ranger]]s, its slow firerate means that in between shots, the '''Health Cultist''' can heal any health lost. ****The [[Commander]] can partially circumvent this by decreasing their firerate. *Fast firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Turret]], are highly recommended to take out the [[Mega Slow]]s and the [[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]]s that are protecting the '''Health Cultist'''. *There are periods of time where the '''Health Cultist''' does not heal any enemies. **During this window of opportunity, you can activate the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability which can help in defeating the '''Health Cultist''' and other enemies. *The '''Health Cultist''' cannot heal back any shield health lost. *Make sure all your towers are set to either ''First'' or ''Strongest'' when the '''Health Cultist''' appears. **Having a mix of targeting settings means that the '''Health Cultist''' will be able to heal more enemies as damage is more spread out. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] can be quite useful against the '''Health Cultist''' as it can deal an instant burst of damage upon collision, killing enemies before they can be healed by the '''Health Cultist'''. *Support towers, such as the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Electroshocker]] can help to slow down the '''Health Cultist''', and keep it away from healing a horde. *It is possible to permanently stall the '''Health Cultist''', preferably with a level 5 [[Brawler]], if you leaked it. It will keep healing, and one level 5 [[Brawler]] will not do enough DPS to take it down. And due to how [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode's economy system works, you can do this to make a lot of cash. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} HealthCultistCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexHealthCultist.png|'''Health Cultist''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *After being defeated, the '''Health Cultist''' used to float in the air and explode. Green lightning would strike its body, though this would not grant [[enemies]] any additional buff. *Unusually, the '''Health Cultist''' only appears once in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, despite not being a major boss. *The healing ability is similar to the removed enemies, the [[Witch Doctor]], as it heals nearby zombies within its range. **However, the [[Witch Doctor]] can heal 20% of an enemy's current health at random times. They also cannot heal themselves. The '''Health Cultist''' heals enemies much more quickly, can heal itself and heals 2.5% of an enemy's maximum health. *The '''Health Cultist''' had several variants before it was added to the game. **One variant an orange color scheme while the other had a purple color scheme.[[File:HealthCultistVariantsProof.png|280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1276691500013944833 *The incantation circle the '''Health Cultist''' creates is a reference to ''Doctor Strange'', a superhero from the ''Marvel'' comics. *The '''Health Cultist's''' hood is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|17408016|Hood of the International Order of Buildmasters}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Health Cultist''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Health Cultist's''' death explosion changed. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **'''Health Cultist's''' death animation removed. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Health Cultist''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Void Cultist]]. Now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. ==References== {{Hardcore|[[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] & [[Molten Boss]]|Wave 44|Health Cultist, [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]], [[Soul]], [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] & [[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Soul Stealer]]|Wave 45|[[Fallen]], [[Soul Boss]] & [[Necromancer Boss]]|Wave 46|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
